```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, comment = "", results = "asis")
run_dir <- params$run_dir
s <- jsonlite::fromJSON(file.path(run_dir, "run_summary.json"), simplifyVector = TRUE)
`%||%` <- function(x, y) if (is.null(x) || length(x) == 0) y else x
fig <- function(name) {
  p <- file.path(run_dir, "figures", paste0(name, ".png"))
  if (file.exists(p)) knitr::include_graphics(p) else invisible(NULL)
}
kable <- function(x, ...) if (!is.null(x) && length(x) && NROW(x)) knitr::kable(x, ...) else invisible(NULL)
safe_label <- function(x) gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_-]+", "_", x)
```

Created `r s$created`. Folder: `r run_dir`

`r if (nzchar(s$notes %||% "")) paste0("Notes: ", s$notes)`

## Input

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| File | `r s$input$path` |
| Format | `r s$input$format` (acquisition mode `r s$input$acquisition_mode`) |
| MD5 | `r s$input$md5` |
| Size (MB) | `r s$input$size_mb` |
| FASTA | `r if (length(s$input$fasta)) paste(s$input$fasta, collapse = ", ") else "none"` |
| Precursor confidence | `r s$input$confidence` |
| Runs / peptides / proteins | `r s$data$n_runs` / `r s$data$n_peptides` / `r s$data$n_proteins` |
| Excluded in annotation | `r if (length(s$excluded_in_annotation)) paste(s$excluded_in_annotation, collapse = ", ") else "none"` |
| Excluded after QC | `r if (length(s$excluded_after_qc)) paste(s$excluded_after_qc, collapse = ", ") else "none"` |
| Search engine | `r if (is.null(s$search)) "no log found" else sprintf("%s (started %s, %s files; settings in search_engine_settings.txt)", s$search$version, s$search$started, s$search$n_files)` |

```{r}
cat("\n\n**Runs per group**\n\n"); kable(s$groups)
```

`r if (is.null(s$design)) "" else "## Design check"`

```{r, eval = !is.null(s$design)}
m <- s$design$messages
cat(paste0("- **", m$level, "**: ", m$text, collapse = "\n"), "\n\n")
if (!is.null(s$design$batch_table)) { cat("\n\n**Runs per group and batch**\n\n"); print(knitr::kable(s$design$batch_table)) }
```

`r if (is.null(s$scorecard)) "" else "## Run scorecard (search-engine statistics per run)"`

```{r, eval = !is.null(s$scorecard)}
sc <- s$scorecard
cat(sprintf("Flags within %s (%s MAD; identifications below %.0f%% of the median). %d of %d runs have at least one flag; two or more: %s.\n\n",
            sc$summary$strata, format(sc$params$mad_k), 100 * sc$params$id_fraction, sc$summary$n_flagged, sc$summary$n_runs,
            if (length(sc$summary$runs_two_or_more)) paste(sc$summary$runs_two_or_more, collapse = ", ") else "none"))
if (length(sc$summary$batch_differences)) cat(sprintf("Systematic differences between batches (Kruskal-Wallis p < 0.01): %s.\n\n", paste(sc$summary$batch_differences, collapse = "; ")))
cat("\n\n**Flag rules**\n\n"); print(knitr::kable(sc$rules))
cat("\n\n**Systematic differences**\n\n"); print(knitr::kable(sc$systematic, digits = 4))
```

```{r, eval = !is.null(s$scorecard), out.width = "100%"}
fig("run_scorecard")
```

`r if (is.null(s$qc)) "" else "## Cohort quality control"`

```{r, eval = !is.null(s$qc)}
cat(sprintf("Matrix: %d proteins x %d runs; normalisation %s, roll-up %s; outlier flags use %d MAD within %s.\n\n",
            s$qc$n_proteins, s$qc$n_runs, s$qc$params$norm, s$qc$params$rollup, s$qc$params$mad_k, s$qc$params$flag_strata))
cat(sprintf("Missing fraction: median %.3f, maximum %.3f. Minimum median correlation %.3f.\n\n",
            s$qc$missing_fraction_median, s$qc$missing_fraction_max, s$qc$median_correlation_min))
cat("Runs with two or more flags: ", if (length(s$qc$candidate_outliers)) paste(s$qc$candidate_outliers, collapse = ", ") else "none", "\n")
```

```{r, eval = !is.null(s$qc), out.width = "100%"}
fig("qc_missingness")
```

```{r, eval = !is.null(s$qc), out.width = "49%", fig.show = "hold"}
fig("qc_medians"); fig("qc_pca"); fig("qc_correlation"); fig("qc_drift"); fig("qc_batch"); fig("qc_pairs"); fig("qc_outliers")
```

`r if (is.null(s$dea)) "" else "## Differential analysis"`

```{r, eval = !is.null(s$dea)}
p <- s$dea$params
cat(sprintf("Filter: >= %d peptides per protein, detected in >= %.0f%% of runs; normalisation %s; roll-up %s; model %s; second engine limma-trend for concordance and treat.\n\n",
            p$min_peptides_per_protein, 100 * p$min_detect_fraction, p$norm, p$rollup, p$dea_algorithm))
cat("\n\n**Contrast summary** (n_hits uses the stated gate; n_hits_treat = limma treat q; n_fragile = hits lost in leave-one-out; n_detection_only = seen in one group only)\n\n")
print(knitr::kable(s$dea$summary, digits = 3))
```

```{r, eval = !is.null(s$dea), results = "asis"}
for (lab in s$dea$summary$contrast) {
  cat(sprintf("\n\n### %s\n\n", lab))
  cc <- s$dea$contrasts[[lab]]
  if (!is.null(cc)) {
    cat(sprintf("Gate: %s. %d of %d proteins pass.\n\n", cc$gate, cc$n_hit, cc$n_tested))
    if (!is.null(cc$loo)) cat(sprintf("Leave-one-out: %d hits fragile, %d robust (%d %s refits). Definition: %s.\n\n", cc$loo$n_fragile, cc$loo$n_robust, cc$loo$units, cc$loo$unit_type, cc$loo$definition))
    if (!is.null(cc$treat)) cat(sprintf("limma treat: %d hits (%s).\n\n", cc$treat$n_hits, cc$treat$definition))
    if (!is.null(cc$detection)) cat(sprintf("Detection-only differences: %d proteins (%d case only, %d control only); %s.\n\n", cc$detection$n, cc$detection$n_case_only, cc$detection$n_control_only, cc$detection$definition))
  }
  f <- file.path(run_dir, "figures", paste0("volcano_", safe_label(lab), ".png"))
  if (file.exists(f)) cat(sprintf("![](%s){width=70%%}\n\n", f))
  t <- file.path(run_dir, "tables", paste0("dea_", safe_label(lab), "_hits.csv"))
  if (file.exists(t)) {
    h <- utils::read.csv(t, nrows = 20)
    if (nrow(h)) { cat("\n\n**First 20 hits** (sorted by p)\n\n"); print(knitr::kable(h[, intersect(c("protein_id", "gene_symbol", "log2FC", "pvalue", "qvalue", "treat_q", "npep", "loo_n_kept", "loo_n_refits", "loo_fragile"), names(h))], digits = 4)) }
  }
  t2 <- file.path(run_dir, "tables", paste0("dea_", safe_label(lab), "_detection_only.csv"))
  if (file.exists(t2)) {
    h2 <- utils::read.csv(t2, nrows = 15)
    if (nrow(h2)) { cat("\n\n**Detection-only differences (first 15)**\n\n"); print(knitr::kable(h2[, intersect(c("protein_id", "gene_symbol", "pattern", "n_detected_case", "n_case", "n_detected_control", "n_control", "fisher_p", "fisher_q", "npep_max"), names(h2))], digits = 4)) }
  }
}
```

`r if (is.null(s$rescue)) "" else "## Rescue classification"`

```{r, eval = !is.null(s$rescue)}
cat(sprintf("Disease contrast: %s. Treatment contrast: %s. Drug-only contrast: %s.\n\nGate: %s\n\n",
            s$rescue$labels$disease, s$rescue$labels$treatment, if (is.na(s$rescue$labels$drug)) "none" else s$rescue$labels$drug, s$rescue$gate))
cat("\n\n**Definitions**\n\n"); kable(data.frame(tier = names(s$rescue$definitions), definition = unlist(s$rescue$definitions)))
cat("\n\n**Counts**\n\n"); kable(s$rescue$counts)
```

```{r, eval = !is.null(s$rescue), out.width = "70%"}
fig("rescue_disease_vs_treatment")
```

`r if (is.null(s$enrichment)) "" else "## Enrichment"`

```{r, eval = !is.null(s$enrichment), results = "asis"}
for (nm in names(s$enrichment)) {
  e <- s$enrichment[[nm]]
  cat(sprintf("\n\n### %s\n\n%s, %s: %d sets tested on %d genes (%d of %d proteins mapped)%s.\n\n", nm, e$method, e$collection, e$n_sets_tested, e$n_genes, e$n_mapped, e$n_total,
              if (!is.null(e$background) && !is.na(e$background)) paste0("; background = ", e$background) else ""))
  print(knitr::kable(e$top, digits = 4))
  f <- file.path(run_dir, "figures", paste0("enrichment_", safe_label(nm), ".png"))
  if (file.exists(f)) cat(sprintf("\n\n![](%s){width=80%%}\n\n", f))
}
```

`r if (is.null(s$adapters)) "" else "## Upload tables for external tools"`

```{r, eval = !is.null(s$adapters)}
a <- s$adapters
cat(paste0("- ", a$notes, collapse = "\n"), "\n\n")
for (nm in names(a$contrasts)) {
  cc <- a$contrasts[[nm]]
  cat(sprintf("- **%s**: %s; %d tested, %d mapped, %d unique symbols, %d hits. Files in `adapters/`: %s, %s, %s, %s, %s.\n",
              cc$contrast, cc$identifier, cc$n_tested, cc$n_mapped, cc$n_unique_symbols, cc$n_hits, cc$ipa, cc$ipathwayguide, cc$string_hits, cc$string_values, cc$cytoscape_nodes))
}
```

## Software

R `r s$versions$R` on `r s$versions$platform`.

```{r}
v <- s$versions$packages
kable(data.frame(package = names(v), version = unlist(lapply(v, function(x) if (is.null(x)) NA else x))), row.names = FALSE)
```

Files: `parameters.json` (every parameter), `package_versions.json`, `session_info.txt`, `search_engine_settings.txt` (when a log was found), `tables/`, `figures/` (PDF and PNG), `adapters/`.
